key_insight: SympFormer derives inertial attention blocks from damped Hamiltonian dynamics on probability-measure spaces, extending the gradient-flow view of attention.
engineering_relevance: The resulting geometric corrections to token and momentum updates offer a principled way to improve attention blocks beyond momentum-only updates.
method: Develop local-mobility geometry for Otto- and softmax-Wasserstein settings and quotient Stein geometry for linear attention.
Characterize domains for softmax gradient flows and inertial Hamiltonian dynamics.
Analyze linear-attention existence and blow-up, linking continuous moment growth to discrete token-norm thresholds.
evidence_signal: In decoder-only, nanoGPT-style experiments on TinyStories and OpenWebText, geometric corrections lower validation next-token negative log-likelihood relative to momentum-only controls.
watch_item: The abstract reports no improvement magnitudes or computational overhead, and theoretical stability depends on explicit domain and existence conditions.
paper_title: SympFormer: Inertial Attention Blocks from Damped Hamiltonian Dynamics on Spaces of Probability Measures
